ITA.note: World #1 wine exporter by VOLUME in 2024: 21.7 mhl (~2170 kt), up 3.2%, value EUR 8.1bn (OIV State of the World Vine and Wine Sector 2024). Production ~44 mhl. Wine here in kt (1 kt approx 10,000 hl / 1 million litres); industry quotes hl/value.

ESP.note: World #2 exporter by volume and #1 BULK exporter in 2024: 20.0 mhl (~2000 kt), a decade low by volume but value up 1.4% to EUR 3.0bn (OIV 2024). Bulk is ~55% of shipments; the ESP-FRA bulk flow is the largest single wine flow on earth. kt basis: 1 kt approx 10,000 hl.

FRA.note: World #1 exporter by VALUE in 2024 (EUR 11.7bn, OIV 2024) but only ~3rd by volume (~12.3 mhl / 1230 kt). Also a major bulk IMPORTER (Spanish bulk for blending), so net volume trade is far smaller than the value rank suggests. Low 2024 harvest. kt basis: 1 kt approx 10,000 hl.

CHL.note: Southern Hemisphere export leader; ~7.8 mhl (~780 kt) exported in 2024 (OIV 2024). Bottled and bulk to the UK, China, USA, Brazil, Japan. FTA access to China; 2024 China volumes down ~15% as Australian wine returned.

AUS.note: ~6.2 mhl (~620 kt) exported in 2024 (OIV 2024). The UK is the largest market by volume; China rebounded sharply after the March 2024 removal of anti-dumping duties. Mix of branded bottled and bulk wine.

ZAF.note: South Africa exported ~3.8 mhl (~380 kt) in 2024 (OIV 2024). Large bulk component to the UK, Germany and France; bottled to the UK and within Africa (Namibia).

ARG.note: Argentina exported ~2.7 mhl (~270 kt) in 2024 (OIV 2024 / INV). Malbec-led bottled to the USA and UK plus bulk to the USA and Brazil; a large domestic market absorbs most output.

USA.note: World #1 wine IMPORTER by VALUE: USD 6.76bn in 2024 (Comtrade/vinetur), led by France (USD 2.51bn) and Italy (USD 2.25bn) - together ~70% of value. Also the #1 consuming nation. California-led production ~22 mhl. kt basis: 1 kt approx 10,000 hl.

DEU.note: Among the world's largest wine importers by VOLUME: ~12.7 mhl (~1270 kt) in 2024, a two-decade low, down 6.9% (wein.plus / Comtrade). Spain overtook Italy as the top volume supplier in 2024. Hamburg/Bremen also re-export. kt basis: 1 kt approx 10,000 hl.

GBR.note: Major importer; ~12.6 mhl (~1260 kt) in 2024, up 2.4% on rising BULK imports (vinetur/Comtrade). Italy leads by volume (~24%), then Australia and France; France leads by value. Negligible domestic production. A significant re-export hub. kt basis: 1 kt approx 10,000 hl.

CHN.note: China imports ~3 mhl (~300 kt) in 2024 (OIV/customs); a market well off its mid-2010s peak. Australia rebounded hard after the March 2024 duty removal; France and Chile both fell ~15-21% in volume. Domestic output declining.

CAN.note: Canada imported ~4.5 mhl (~450 kt) in 2024 from Italy, the USA, France, Australia, Chile and Spain (FAOSTAT 2024 partner flows). The large CAN-USA flow in the seed reflects re-export/transit and bottled imports. Small domestic production (Ontario/BC).

NLD.note: The Netherlands (Rotterdam) is a wine import/re-export hub; ~5.5 mhl (~550 kt) imported in 2024 from Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal and Chile (FAOSTAT 2024). Much is re-exported into the EU. No meaningful domestic production.

BEL.note: Belgium imported ~3.8 mhl (~380 kt) in 2024, chiefly from France, Italy, Spain and South Africa (FAOSTAT 2024). Part transit/re-export via Antwerp. Negligible domestic production.

JPN.note: Japan imported ~2.5 mhl (~250 kt) in 2024 from France, Chile, Spain and Italy (FAOSTAT 2024). Chile holds a strong position via the EPA tariff phase-out; France leads by value.

BRA.note: Brazil imported ~1.5 mhl (~150 kt) in 2024, led by Chile (Mercosur/FTA access), Argentina, Portugal and Italy (FAOSTAT 2024). Domestic production is concentrated in Rio Grande do Sul.

rankings.note: Exporter ranks by VOLUME 2024 from OIV State of the World Vine and Wine Sector (April 2025): Italy 21.7 mhl, Spain 20.0 mhl, France ~12.3 mhl - the top three are ~55% of global export volume. Note France is #1 by VALUE (EUR 11.7bn). Importer ranks by volume 2024 (OIV + national customs via Comtrade): Germany 12.7 mhl and the UK 12.6 mhl lead by volume, the USA leads by value (USD 6.76bn). 1 kt approx 10,000 hl.

companies.name: E. & J. Gallo Winery
companies.note: World's largest wine company by volume (privately held; family-owned since 1933). Vast California production plus imported brands (Barefoot, Carlo Rossi, Apothic, La Marca). 2024 basis.
companies.improve: Should disclose annual case/volume figures and the split between domestic and imported sourcing.

companies.name: Treasury Wine Estates
companies.note: ASX-listed global wine major; owns Penfolds, Wolf Blass, 19 Crimes and Beringer (US). The March 2024 China duty removal was a major tailwind for Penfolds in 2024.
companies.improve: Should report kt-equivalent volumes by region (it discloses value/cases) for trade-flow attribution.

companies.name: Vina Concha y Toro
companies.note: Latin America's largest wine producer/exporter (NYSE/Santiago-listed); Casillero del Diablo is a global brand. Anchors much of Chile's UK/China/Brazil export volume. 2024 basis.
companies.improve: Should map brand volumes to specific destination markets to validate Chile's bilateral flows.

companies.name: Pernod Ricard (Wine & Spirits)
companies.note: Global spirits-and-wine major; wine brands include Jacob's Creek (Australia), Brancott Estate (NZ) and Campo Viejo (Spain). 2024 basis; it has been divesting parts of its wine portfolio.
companies.improve: Should clarify which wine brands remain after recent portfolio divestitures.

companies.name: Castel Freres
companies.note: France's largest wine company by volume (privately held); dominant in French retail and a major presence in African markets. 2024 basis.
companies.improve: Should publish volume figures (private company; limited disclosure) and African production splits.

companies.name: Accolade Wines
companies.note: Major Southern-Hemisphere bulk-and-bottled producer (Hardys, Echo Falls) with a large UK bottling operation. Acquired by the Australian Wine Holdco consortium in 2024. Anchors AUS/ZAF bulk flows to the UK.
companies.improve: Should report post-2024-acquisition volumes and the UK bulk-bottling throughput.

global.note: Global wine (HS2204), kt (1 kt approx 10,000 hl). From OIV State of the World Vine and Wine Sector reports. 2024 was a historic low: production ~226 mhl (22,600 kt), consumption ~214 mhl (lowest since the early 1960s) and export volume 99.8 mhl (9,980 kt, lowest since 2010) even as the average export PRICE hit a record - a low-volume, high-price market.

forecast.method: OIV / OECD-FAO trend envelope; structural decline in volume continues while value stays resilient; 2030=2024x(1+rate)^6
